name: Grey Feather
source: Grey Feather centers around Doctor Avery, a 59 year old scientist who studies souls. One day he’s visited by someone who looks uncannily like his long-dead son. From there, he’s dragged into misadventures and conspiracies, and has to try to survive more than a few dangerous situations.
translation: 《灰羽》围绕59岁的灵魂研究科学家艾弗里博士展开。某天，一个长得与他早已去世的儿子惊人相似的人来拜访他。此后，艾弗里被卷入一场场冒险与阴谋，必须设法从接连不断的危险处境中活下来。
